name: HospitalConfig
description: System-wide configurable settings for the hospital, such as operating hours, holidays, and policies.

attributes.name: settingName
attributes.description: The unique name of the configuration setting.

attributes.name: settingValue
attributes.description: The value of the configuration setting.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A description of what the setting controls.

attributes.name: dataType
attributes.description: The expected data type of the settingValue.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: A category to group related settings (e.g., 'OperatingHours', 'Policies').
